description: Type-safe Object-Graph Mapper for Neo4j (TypeScript) that uses GraphQL SDL as the schema. Continues @neo4j/graphql-ogm, which was removed from @neo4j/graphql 6.0.0: same OGM / Model API, plus Prisma-style queries, a typed select API, node-level security policies, and neo4j-driver 5 and 6 support. Not GrafeoDB and not the Java Neo4j OGM.
rules: Install with `npm install grafeo-ogm neo4j-driver graphql`; neo4j-driver 5 and 6 are both supported.
Run `npx grafeo generate` and construct `new OGM<ModelMap, InterfaceModelMap>({ typeDefs, driver })` so models, where, select and inputs are typed.
Use the generated enums (`SortDirection.Asc`, `MyEnum.Value`), not string literals, in where, sort and inputs.
Pass either `select` (typed object) or `selectionSet` (GraphQL string) to a query method, never both.

With `policies`, run every request through `ogm.withContext(ctx).model(...)`; a bare `ogm.model(...)` applies no policy. Type the context with a third generic: `new OGM<ModelMap, InterfaceModelMap, RequestCtx>(...)`.
For new code pass `strict: true`: it turns on the corrected behaviour for a handful of surprising input shapes (warnings become `OGMError`s) and becomes the default in 3.0.
